Required workflow action: cache authorization state keyed by permission version, not just tenant/role — any cache read for authz must include the current permission-version in the key so a revoke invalidates it immediately, rather than waiting on TTL expiry.

Key safety gate: a regression test that revokes a role and asserts 403 on the next request within the TTL window (not after it) — this is the only proof that closes the race; a shortened TTL alone is provably insufficient and should be rejected as a fix pattern.
